search_text: published ZDI-10-202 ZDI-CAN-705 Sun Java Web Start BasicServiceImpl Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2010-10-12 CVE-2010-3563 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2010-3563 10.0 ['Sun Microsystems'] ['Java Runtime'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of the Sun Java Runtime. User interaction is required in that a target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists within the com.sun.jnlp.BasicServiceImpl class. By abusing how Web Start retrieves security policies, an attacker can forge their own and force the removal of sandbox restrictions. Successful exploitation leads to code execution under the context of the user running the browser. Sun Microsystems has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
